Alex (ACME): Hey team, we merged two orgs yesterday and the trial credits for the merged accounts aren't decreasing. We made ~1.1k tokens of requests but the balance still shows full trial. Any idea? :confused:
Jamie (Support): Sorry about that — can you share org_id and a sample request id or session id? Also did you merge via the org transfer flow or link accounts?
Alex (ACME): We used the org-merge API around 2025-05-10T14:12 UTC. Org IDs: org_old=org-A-123, org_new=org-B-987. Sample request id: req_0a7b9c. User email: alice@acme.com
Jamie (Support): Thanks — pinging @Ryan oncall to check ledger side :eyes:
Ryan (Oncall): looking. Can you paste the /metrics/logs for req_0a7b9c or the node that served it? Also any finalize webhook ids?
Alex (ACME): here's a chunk from our client logs: ```json
{"ts":"2025-05-10T14:13:02Z","req":"req_0a7b9c","org":"org-B-987","tokens":1142,"status":200}
```
Maya (DevEx): do you see any "finalize" events from our streaming sessions? sometimes missing finalize causes no debit.
Alex (ACME): We see finalize events for other sessions but not for this one — but many requests succeeded.
Ryan (Oncall): I pulled the internal request trace for req_0a7b9c — looks like the billing owner was still mapped to org-A-123 in the ledger lookup due to alias mapping not refreshed after merge. Finalize route checked ledger_owner != request_org and skipped burn.
Li (Billing): that's a known edge: concurrent merges + in-flight finalizes can cause alias race where ledger owner lookup returns the pre-merge owner and the debit is skipped. We'll need a resync and reprocess.
Jamie (Support): Immediate workaround: we can run a manual alias resync for ACME and then reprocess the finalize queue for the affected request ids. Alex — you ok for us to proceed?
Alex (ACME): please run it — our customer-facing dashboard is showing wrong balance and users are noticing.
Ryan (Oncall): I'll push a hotfix to make finalize idempotent against alias mismatches (extra owner-lookup guard). Deploying now.
deploy-bot: starting deployment hotfix/alias-finalize -> prod
deploy-bot: deployment successful (deploy-12345) :white_check_mark:
Li (Billing): I've queued a ledger re-burn job for org-B-987 for requests since 2025-05-10T14:00 UTC. Expected completion ~30m. That will apply missing debits and emit adjustment events.
Alex (ACME): thanks. One question — could this affect promo credits or paid quotas?
Ryan (Oncall): It can affect trial/promo cases if alias mapping changed during merge. We'll run a targeted scan for promos and flag any anomalies. I'll also kick off a post-mortem and link the runbook.
Maya (DevEx): For customer comms, suggest a one-line note in release: "Org merges may temporarily show stale trial balances; contact support for expedited resync." Also add the customer-facing repro steps in the KB.
Jamie (Support): I'll follow up with ACME when re-burn completes and confirm balances. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
